verdict.rationale: Clerk is a user-management SaaS with a dashboard, so in-product AI insights on user data is a fair axis. The evidence shows no feature that gives AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. Bot-detection machine learning is an adjacent fraud control, the MCP server only supplies SDK snippets and account tools to external agents, and the public logs endpoint is a developer building block.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
